messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin is available as capsules, tablets, extended-release tablets, and an oral solution. Strengths vary by product, and different products are not interchangeable.
Neurontin and generic gabapentin
- oral capsules 100 mg, 300 mg, 400 mg
- oral tablets 600 mg, 800 mg
- oral solution 250 mg/5 mL
Relgaabi
- oral capsules 100 mg, 200 mg, 300 mg, 400 mg
Gralise
- extended-release tablets 300 mg, 450 mg, 600 mg, 750 mg, and 900 mg
Horizant (gabapentin enacarbil)
- extended-release tablets 300 mg, 600 mg
Note: The Horizant strengths refer to gabapentin enacarbil, not gabapentin itself, so Horizant doses do not correspond milligram-for-milligram to other gabapentin products.
Triplet: ["Horizant", "has note", "doses do not correspond milligram-for-milligram to other gabapentin products"]

The relation 'has note' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with the additional information or warning specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
E. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or medium specified by the object entity.
